name: us-hsa-form-8889
description: Compute 2026 health savings account limits, the deduction, and taxable distributions under section 223 and Form 8889. Covers who is an eligible individual, the self-only and family contribution limits, the high deductible health plan thresholds, the age-55 catch-up, the last-month rule and its testing period, employer contributions, qualified distributions, the 20 percent additional tax, and the 6 percent tax on excess contributions. Includes the 2026 rules for telehealth, bronze and catastrophic Marketplace plans, and direct primary care arrangements. Trigger on HSA, Form 8889, health savings account, HDHP, catch-up contribution. Federal only, tax year 2026.
